title: Check umask used by running processes
summary: Inspect the umask value currently applied to all processes running under your user account. This helps debug permission issues with background services.

steps.explain: List all processes for the current user and extract their Umask value from /proc.
steps.cmd: ps -u $USER -o pid= | xargs -I % sh -c 'echo PID=%, $(grep '^Umask:' "/proc/%/status"), Process=$(ps -w -p % -o cmd=)'
steps.expect: A list of PIDs, their Umask values, and command names.
